observed_behavior.document: Emits version 2.1.0 with a SchemaStore schema URI and one run.
observed_behavior.rules: Emits the driver name without a rules inventory.
observed_behavior.severity: Sanitizes to SARIF none, note, warning, or error and defaults unknown severity to error.
observed_behavior.locations: Emits a relative issue path, line, and a start column clamped to at least one without a snippet.
observed_behavior.suppressions: Does not emit a policy suppression inventory.

observed_behavior.document: Emits version 2.1.0 with the oasis-tcs schema mirror and one run.
observed_behavior.rules: Emits reporting descriptors, tool version, semantic version, and taxonomies.
observed_behavior.severity: Maps high to error, medium to warning, and low to note.
observed_behavior.suppressions: Uses the standard result suppressions array for finding-specific suppressions.

local_profile.document: Emits version 2.1.0 with a SchemaStore schema URI and one run.
local_profile.rules: Emits deterministic rule descriptors and governed rule metadata.
local_profile.severity: Maps error to error, warning to warning, info to note, and unknown rules to warning.
local_profile.locations: Emits repository-relative paths and source positions without snippets.
local_profile.suppressions: Retains policy exceptions and source suppressions as run property-bag extensions rather than result suppressions.
